title: ADB Approves  Million Loan for PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSGMBY)
summary: Accelerates Subprogram 2 for rooftop solar installations across 10 million low & middle-income households.

blocks.content: Accelerates Subprogram 2 for rooftop solar installations across 10 million low & middle-income households.

items: Multilateral Funding: ADB  loan adds to  package previously approved by World Bank.
Subsidy Structure: PMSGMBY (₹75,021 cr outlay) provides ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW, and ₹78,000 for 3 kW solar systems.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: PMSGMBY launched Feb 13, 2024 by PM Modi | ADB HQ: Manila, Philippines.
